description: Director.Recovery.MonitoringPhase deliberately excludes kind == :materializer from component monitoring, and bedrock-q67.7's distributor death-healing excludes the system shard because clients route tag 0 via the TSL's metadata_materializer field, which a shard_materializers delta cannot update (LayoutIndex.get_materializer_for_shard/3 prefers metadata_materializer for tag 0). Net effect: if the metadata materializer dies, nobody notices - reads of the system shard fail until some unrelated event forces a recovery. Decide the owner: (a) director monitors the metadata materializer specifically and treats its death as a component failure (recovery restart, consistent with the recovery relaxation stalling only for tag 0), or (b) extend the TSL delta channel to update metadata_materializer so the distributor can heal it like any shard (interacts badly with Phase B's plan to delete the delta channel - (a) looks right).
title: System-shard (tag 0) materializer death is unhandled: no monitor, no healing, no recovery trigger
